text: Seabrook Town pushes forward strongly on the left flank near Harbour City’s goal at the near end. Their formation stretches wide, creating space as players advance quickly into the final third. Multiple crosses come into Harbour City’s penalty area, forcing the defence to respond under pressure. Despite the attacks, the score remains Harbour City 2, Seabrook Town 0 at 48 minutes.[#935]
